subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's in these airline reviews — I'm not sure which aspect is most worth analyzing.

judge.implied_focus: Service experience quality (particularly crew/staff service and its consistency) as the central aspect worth analyzing in the reviews.

per_column.name: crew_service_quality
per_column.rationale: Directly captures crew/staff service quality — a strong core facet of a service-experience focus.

per_column.name: seat_hardware_condition
per_column.rationale: Concerns physical seat/hardware state, a product/tangible attribute distinct from the service-experience focus, pulling toward a different aspect.

per_column.name: food_quality_assessment
per_column.rationale: Food quality is a separate catering facet; relevant to reviews generally but drifts from a crew/service-centred focus.

per_column.name: special_meal_handling
per_column.rationale: Handling of special meals is a service-delivery behaviour, partially bridging catering and service.

per_column.name: disruption_handling_quality
per_column.rationale: How disruptions are managed is a clear service-quality facet, aligning with a service focus.

per_column.name: service_decline_signal
per_column.rationale: Flags deteriorating service, a temporal/consistency facet of the service-quality focus.

per_column.name: premium_economy_value_gap
per_column.rationale: Concerns value-for-money in a specific cabin class, a pricing/value dimension rather than service quality.

judge.rationale: The columns lean toward a service-experience focus — crew_service_quality, disruption_handling_quality, service_decline_signal, and special_meal_handling all sit on that axis, giving a plausible inferable centre. However, seat_hardware_condition, food_quality_assessment, and premium_economy_value_gap span distinct product/catering/value aspects, so the set reads partly as a general aspect-scan rather than a tightly focused decomposition; this weakens focus_coherence. Where they do cohere around service, the facets are well-differentiated (baseline quality, disruption handling, temporal decline, meal handling) at a useful granularity, supporting a moderate structure score. The implied service-quality focus is genuinely actionable — an analyst could investigate service consistency drivers of recommendation. The mixed scope keeps this from a strong pass on coherence.
